title: Data provenance and licensing at scale
bottleneck: Nobody can say, for a given frontier model, exactly which data it trained on — provenance tracking at trillion-token scale doesn't exist, and web-scale scraping ignores licenses, robots.txt, and consent. This makes copyright compliance unverifiable, bias auditing impossible, and removal of problematic data a matter of hope. The entire training pipeline is effectively undocumented. Most training corpora are assembled from scraped web text with no records of origin, consent, or license status.
why_it_blocks: Regulated deployment requires knowing what's in the model. Without provenance, every model carries unknown legal and safety liabilities.
current_state: Datasheets and opt-out registries are voluntary and incomplete; no major lab publishes full training provenance. Licensing deals cover only major publishers; the long tail of creators has no mechanism for consent or compensation.
